ancestor_issues.summary: Umbrella tracking epic establishing general React to Web Components parity guidelines, acceptance criteria, and component review checklists.
ancestor_issues.reason: Issue #17992 is a broad umbrella initiative for syncing all Carbon Web Components with React. Its contents provide high-level project context and review criteria rather than specific actionable requirements for the combo-box component fix.

requirements.requirement: General parity mandate to update web components to match React component implementations and visual styles.
requirements.source_quote: Update existing web components to match React. Experimental components/features can be excluded until they reach stable status in React.
requirements.reason: Provides general initiative context; concrete component-level styling requirements are already captured in direct issues #20120 and #20849.

requirements.requirement: Standard acceptance criteria across parity issues covering API updates, visual/style alignments, and Storybook documentation matching.
requirements.source_quote:
- update API for new/deprecated functionality
  - in cases where this can cause breaking changes (like changing a property name), the old property name should be @deprecated in addition to adding a new one
- update component visuals/styles
- Storybook stories and documentation
requirements.reason: Generic project-wide acceptance criteria checklist for parity issues, not specific to combo-box.

requirements.requirement: Procedural guidelines for PR reviews including theme checks, browser checks, and UX/design team review requirements.
requirements.source_quote:
Check against the four themes
- Check against the different browsers
- Storybooks need to match
  - Controls - i.e. RTL - visually make they present. Also make sure they work!
  - Ensure the prop tables have parity.
requirements.reason: Procedural review workflow guidance for human reviewers.

requirements.requirement: Umbrella list of web components to track parity across the entire library.
requirements.source_quote:
### existing web components
- [ ] Ai-label
- [ ] Aspect-ratio
- [ ] Code-snippet
requirements.reason: Epic tracking checklist of unrelated sibling components.
